title: Project Pushkalāvatī / Nirgundi: the Sanskrit parser, its data-driven rule compiler and the Sūtram rule-rewrite language (BUILD-0024 to BUILD-0027)
description: The integrated research repository for the Sanskrit source inventory (all 3,983 sūtras as data), a data-driven rule compiler, the observed-form bootstrap, the Sūtram rule-rewrite language, the Sanskrit analysis pipeline, Hindawi ports and Romenagri transliteration tooling. This deposit preserves BUILD-0024, BUILD-0025, BUILD-0026 and BUILD-0027 exactly as delivered: each original archive is included byte for byte, the repository history carries one commit per build, and the final tree is BUILD-0026 with the BUILD-0027 results and correction applied. Twenty files that BUILD-0025 and BUILD-0026 dropped in packaging, including the Pages workflow, are restored from BUILD-0024, and the shell scripts are executable again; SEED-NOTE.md records each. Third-party components keep their own licences.
